messages.subject: Re: Possible maximization warning in multisesion model with D~habitat covariate from mask
parts: The '/' prefix on your mask covariate is a mistake. Model fits in 12 minutes when you remove it. NAs in the covariate values should be fixed somehow (maybe see ?skink example). Otherwise these are set to zero, which is not what you want.
